Mostar, 21 September 2023: the first European group game a club from Bosnia and Herzegovina ever played. Zrinjski v AZ Alkmaar under the White Hill — nil–three at half-time, four–three at the end. Filmed from the stand.

I WAS THERE is FAN LIFE's matchday blog — real nights, filmed from the stand. Every fact comes from the FAN LIFE archive.
